checks.detail: assets/js/core/runtime-config.js must keep instantShellNavigation disabled by default.

checks.name: feature-flags-expose-instant-navigation-aliases
checks.detail: feature flag aliases must point to instantShellNavigation for controlled future reactivation.

checks.detail: app.js must not swap partial page content unless instantShellNavigation is explicitly enabled.

checks.name: popstate-does-not-reload-when-native-navigation-default-is-disabled

checks.name: drawer-imports-use-shared-ui-path
checks.detail: No HTML references the legacy home drawer path.

decision.reason: Full-document navigation is the safe default until all page-level CSS/JS lifecycle contracts are stable. This avoids first-load/partial-route layout drift that only normalizes after F5.
